card.name: Punctuation just before web page endings
card.fires_on: Punctuation or name pieces at the point where an article body ends and page extras begin, such as an author byline, a dictionary prompt, or a link. Fires on the final period, closing quote, or ellipsis.

modes.label: Author byline
modes.description: Initials, commas and names inside an author credit after the article text.

modes.label: Feedback prompt ellipsis
modes.description: The ellipsis ending the prompt 'Please share what surprised you most' on encyclopedia pages.
modes.example: Please share what surprised you most<<...>>

modes.label: Closing punctuation before page links
modes.description: A closing quote or period right before a pointer to another page or a site element.
modes.example: undergo an antibiotic therapy<<." >>Turn to pertussis on Page
